description: This file defines the 'Topic' model class within the Opencart administrative CMS module. It includes methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting topic records, as well as managing associated descriptions, stores, layouts, and SEO URLs. It facilitates interactions with the database and cache related to CMS topics in an OpenCart project.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Represents the CMS Topic model in OpenCart, handling CRUD operations and associations related to CMS topics.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Creates a new topic record in the database, including descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts, then clears cache and returns the new topic ID.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Updates an existing topic record and its related descriptions, store associations, SEO URLs, and layouts. Clears cache afterwards.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Deletes a topic and all its related data (descriptions, stores, SEO URLs, layouts) from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific topic, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Fetches a list of topics based on optional filters, with caching support.

methods.name: getTotalTopics
methods.description: Returns the total count of topics matching optional filtering criteria.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description entry for a specific topic in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Removes all description records associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language across topics.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific topic, indexed by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all topic descriptions filtered by a specific language ID.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Associates a topic with a store.

methods.name: deleteStores
methods.description: Removes all store associations for a specific topic.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific topic.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Associates a topic with a layout and store.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Removes all layout associations for a specific topic.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes all topic layout associations for a specific layout ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout associations for a specific topic.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the count of topic layouts associated with a specific layout ID.
